identityCorrections.supports: Organizer event page explicitly pairs 洪洲 and Mike Hong, CTO Biren Technology. Identity alias only, not a technical work.

limitations: Do not add normalized group counts across datasets as unique people. Names, event appearances, technical works and admitted people are different units.
